Reproduction.Steps: Open the normal preview motion dropdown and scroll toward pose 20 without selecting a motion.
Reproduction.BeforeFix: UI stopped responding. Two debugger samples showed the UI thread in WinUI ItemsControl/ComboBox automation traversal and UIAutomationCore UiaNodeTraverser sibling traversal.
Reproduction.Cause: MOD motions can have identical display names. Binding equal strings as items allows WinUI to reuse automation peers and form a sibling traversal cycle when more rows are realized.
Reproduction.Fix: Give every motion a distinct Observable object and bind DisplayMemberPath to Name in both preview dropdowns. Preserve the original names, ordering and selected-index mapping.

AutomatedTests.PackageValidation: Passed: 68 native PE files, x64 app/adapters, complete resources and resolved imports, no CLR.

UiChecks: Normal preview: repeated the original wheel-scroll sequence past pose 20; the UI stayed responsive.
Normal preview: scrolled through repeated identical MOD labels; accessibility traversal completed in 158 ms.
Normal preview: navigated to the last entry with End and returned with Home, then selected pose 20 and observed the changed character pose.
Editor preview: scrolled past pose 20 and into the identical MOD labels; accessibility traversal completed in 187 ms with distinct item nodes.
Editor preview: selected the third identically named NewMakerPoses pose 01 entry and observed the changed character pose; the draft remained saved at r0.
Limitations: An existing MOD choice referencing missing resource 74/Ev_Shower_A_00 still reports a nonfatal switch failure and retains the previous motion; the dropdown remains responsive.
This regression run used one female card containing duplicate motion labels. It did not repeat the previous full male/female motion sweep.
